refresh_law: Every current-state, carrier, entitlement, source, host, permission, and proof fact must be refreshed from its canonical owner before action.

capabilities.name: fresh_leader_bootstrap
capabilities.user_outcome: A fresh Sol reconstructs the current responsibility and exact next action without prior-chat dependence.
capabilities.evidence_interpretation: Source and historical workstation acceptance exist; cross-account current production experience and measured recovery remain separate.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: One fresh eligible leader reconstructs an unfamiliar responsibility from current owners, catches one stale projection, and reaches the correct first decision without a predecessor transcript.

capabilities.name: business_steward_read
capabilities.user_outcome: One Business cockpit reads useful source-attributed responsibility, attention, runtime, blocker, and surface facts.
capabilities.observed_carrier: Mastermind PR #463 at inspected head 7ffc3821004ab4bf4a63d56f88d18cb5165424d6; refresh before action
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Exact package/app generation, one nonempty authenticated read, explicit degraded state, post-token-expiry refresh read, H1 acceptance, rollback, and two unchanged Personal-Pro controls.

capabilities.name: personal_pro_company_read
capabilities.user_outcome: A Personal-Pro leader can obtain current company evidence even where custom write tools are unavailable.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: One Personal-Pro chat consumes the same allowed source-attributed evidence needed for a correct decision, with unsupported writes explicitly unavailable.
must_not_build: mandatory Business dependency for all reasoning

capabilities.name: bounded_ceo_root_admission
capabilities.user_outcome: An authorized Chairman/Sol instruction creates one canonical root intent and truthful QUEUED receipt.
capabilities.evidence_interpretation: The inspected Executive MCP exposes readonly/fixture modes; source architecture is not a production-write toggle.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: One separately confirmed harmless admission returns one idempotent QUEUED root with dispatched=false and zero unintended Attempt/Worker/Wake effect.

capabilities.name: exact_company_dialogue
capabilities.user_outcome: A worker and its exact parent exchange ACK, progress, blocker, decision, result, continuation, and terminal stop without generic Slack authority.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: A real returned child is consumed by the exact parent and receives an explicit CONTINUE or STOP, with child-only watcher cleanup and no lifecycle inference from delivery.

capabilities.name: global_code_discovery
capabilities.user_outcome: A leader or worker locates relevant code across the company with honest coverage, source, and freshness.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: A real task finds owner/code evidence faster without treating stale, missing, or truncated coverage as proof of absence.
must_not_build: direct upstream semantic MCP as authority

capabilities.name: exact_worktree_semantics
capabilities.user_outcome: A bound worker understands symbols, references, types, and changes in the exact current Attempt worktree.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Python and TypeScript/TSX exact-worktree semantic canary with closed source/result validation, containment, cleanup, and current owner binding.

capabilities.name: isolated_local_workbench_read
capabilities.user_outcome: A worker reads files/images and inspects an exact repository without exposing unrelated machine state.
existing_surfaces: third-party Chat On Steroids patterns as non-authoritative research
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Pinned disposable read-only canary over synthetic files/images, including symlink/path denial, permission revocation, persistence and managed-browser compatibility.
must_not_build: cosmetic folder allowlist presented as shell sandbox

capabilities.name: isolated_local_workbench_write
capabilities.user_outcome: A bound worker patches, builds, and tests one bounded change with attributable effects and cleanup.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: One disposable producer-to-PR result with exact worktree, path collision fence, reviewed command family, process identity, strict result boundary, cleanup, immutable evidence, and parent review.

capabilities.name: durable_execution_and_result_retrieval
capabilities.user_outcome: Work continues after the leader turn and its result can be recovered without duplicate launch.
existing_surfaces: MCP Tasks as optional negotiated protocol research
capabilities.next_useful_proof: One long command/worker survives client disconnect and is retrieved once under the same owner and process identity; cancellation request and actual termination remain distinct.
must_not_build: task handle as exact Chat wake proof

capabilities.name: material_return_exact_reentry
capabilities.user_outcome: A result or decision request wakes the exact responsible leader or reports exact wake unavailability.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Worker completes while leader is inactive; one material event reaches the exact bound leader, which fresh-reads and acts on the same operation, or emits a typed unavailable result.

capabilities.name: exact_chat_inspect_and_foreground
capabilities.user_outcome: The Chairman or system can locate and foreground the exact approved Chat surface without hunting windows.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Installed disposable managed-profile canary demonstrates exact identity, foreground postcondition, restart/reconstitution, transport faults, cross-profile isolation, and rollback.

capabilities.name: exact_chat_succession
capabilities.user_outcome: One logical responsibility survives retirement or failure of its conversation through exactly one verified successor.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Dead predecessor, exact same profile/Project successor, one bootstrap, semantic readiness, generation transition, stale refusal, lost receipt handling, and next governed action.

capabilities.name: all_reachable_mutator_coverage
capabilities.user_outcome: A claim that an old chat cannot perform a given autonomous action is technically supported across every route included in the claim.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Two synthetic chats sharing a principal; one binding transition; inventory and test each enabled mutator; preserve current actor and unrelated siblings; label gaps attended-only or unknown.

capabilities.name: pro_reasoning_portfolio
capabilities.user_outcome: Included Pro capacity is spent on enough high-value architecture, research, debugging, and audit work to materially accelerate the company.
canonical_owners: strategic and Agent OS priority owners
capabilities.next_useful_proof: One bounded council of independent Sol responsibilities, Integrator, Auditor, parking/backpressure, exact placement, and measured accepted-decision improvement without routine Pro polling or account hopping.

capabilities.name: evidence_based_acceptance
capabilities.user_outcome: A leader can tell whether a capability works in the real product or machine path, not merely whether source and CI exist.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: One real producer-to-consumer program slice with exact source/deployment, independent review, negative states, visible product/machine result, durable acceptance, and learning instrumentation.

capabilities.name: chairman_control_room
capabilities.user_outcome: Chris sees current outcomes, obligations, evidence, surfaces, serviceability, and next actions without manual tab archaeology.
canonical_owners: Chairman Control Room and Steward composition
capabilities.next_useful_proof: A real company-state consumer renders honest current/degraded/unknown states, opens exact evidence/surfaces, and reduces Chairman navigation burden without owning state or actions.

capabilities.user_outcome: Mastermind knows whether the improved ChatGPT workflow produces better outcomes for less avoidable overhead.
capabilities.next_useful_proof: Freeze one candidate change and run the paired 24-task protocol with zero catastrophic failures, direct measurements, independent grading, and full per-task reporting.
